moments.title: Strictly's Back!
moments.blurb: The 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing kicks off with its glittering launch show this Saturday, revealing which celebrities are paired with their professional dancers.

angles.name: Launch Night Excitement
angles.copy: Get ready to cha-cha-cha! Strictly Come Dancing returns this Saturday with its big launch. Who are you hoping gets paired with whom? #Strictly

angles.name: New Hosts & Judges
angles.copy: New faces, same sparkle! Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe take over hosting duties for Strictly 2026, with Ellie Taylor on It Takes Two. Tune in for the launch on Saturday!

moments.title: Bake Off Returns with Nigella
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off is back for its 17th series next Tuesday, with a new judge, Nigella Lawson, joining Paul Hollywood in the tent.

angles.name: New Judge Excitement
angles.copy: On your marks, get set, BAKE! The Great British Bake Off returns next Tuesday, and this year Nigella Lawson joins Paul Hollywood as a judge. Are you ready for some kitchen drama?

angles.name: Autumnal Comfort Watch
angles.copy: Autumn officially begins next week, and so does Bake Off! Grab a cuppa and get ready for some comforting bakes (and perhaps a few soggy bottoms). Starts Tuesday on Channel 4.

moments.title: Premier League Matchweek 5
moments.blurb: The Premier League returns this weekend with Matchweek 5, featuring Brentford v Chelsea on Friday, and Tottenham v Aston Villa, Brighton v Arsenal on Saturday.

angles.name: Weekend Football Kicks Off
angles.copy: Back to the beautiful game! Premier League Matchweek 5 kicks off Friday with Brentford vs Chelsea. Who are you backing this weekend?

angles.name: Big Saturday Games
angles.copy: Saturday's Premier League action includes Spurs vs Villa and Brighton vs Arsenal. Crucial points up for grabs already! #PL

moments.title: Gallagher Premiership Season Starts
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Gallagher Premiership Rugby season begins next weekend, September 25-27, with Exeter Chiefs hosting Gloucester on Saturday 26th.

angles.name: Rugby Season Is Here
angles.copy: Get ready for kick-off! The Gallagher Premiership season starts next weekend. Who's your money on for the title this year?

angles.name: Exeter Chiefs Home Opener
angles.copy: Big news for Devon rugby fans! The Exeter Chiefs kick off their Gallagher Premiership season at home against Gloucester next Saturday, September 26th! Get behind the boys!

moments.title: F1 Azerbaijan Grand Prix
moments.blurb: Formula 1 heads to Baku for the Azerbaijan Grand Prix next weekend, September 24-26, the 15th round of the 2026 season.

angles.name: Street Circuit Action
angles.copy: It's a street fight in Baku next weekend as F1 takes on the Azerbaijan Grand Prix! Expect drama, speed, and probably a safety car or two. #F1

angles.name: Championship Battle Heats Up
angles.copy: Another crucial race in the F1 championship battle is just days away. Who will master the Baku City Circuit?

moments.title: André Rieu UK Tour Continues
moments.blurb: The 'King of Waltz' André Rieu brings his spectacular orchestra to Nottingham tomorrow, followed by London on Friday and Birmingham on Saturday.

angles.name: Waltz Into Midweek
angles.copy: André Rieu's enchanting UK tour continues this week, with Nottingham up next tomorrow! Get ready for a night of beautiful music. #AndreRieu

angles.name: Weekend of Waltz
angles.copy: London and Birmingham, get ready for the 'King of Waltz'! André Rieu and his Johann Strauss Orchestra are bringing their incredible show to you this weekend.

moments.title: Loreen's Wildfire Tour Hits UK
moments.blurb: Double Eurovision winner Loreen brings her 'Wildfire Tour' to the UK next week, with dates in Glasgow (Sept 24), Manchester (Sept 25), and London (Sept 26).

angles.name: Eurovision Queen Live
angles.copy: She gave us 'Euphoria' and 'Tattoo'! Double Eurovision champ Loreen is bringing her 'Wildfire Tour' to Glasgow, Manchester, and London next week. Get your tickets! #Loreen

angles.name: Dance Pop Sensation
angles.copy: Loreen is hitting the UK stage next week! Expect powerful vocals and incredible dance-pop anthems. Who's going?

moments.title: The Real Rooneys Docuseries
moments.blurb: A new ten-part docuseries, 'The Real Rooneys', giving inside access to Wayne and Coleen Rooney's lives, premieres on Disney+ and Hulu next Thursday, September 24.

angles.name: Behind the Scenes with Rooneys
angles.copy: Ever wondered what life's like for the Rooneys? A new docuseries, 'The Real Rooneys', drops next Thursday on Disney+! Get ready for exclusive access.

angles.name: Reality TV Buzz
angles.copy: Another big reality show hitting screens next week! The Real Rooneys promises an unfiltered look at the famous couple. Will you be tuning in?

moments.title: John Coltrane 100th Birthday Tribute
moments.blurb: Legendary jazz saxophonist John Coltrane would have celebrated his 100th birthday next Wednesday, September 23, 2026.

angles.name: Jazz Icon Centennial
angles.copy: Remembering a true musical pioneer. Jazz legend John Coltrane would have turned 100 next Wednesday. His influence on music is immeasurable. #JohnColtrane

angles.name: Celebrating a Genius
angles.copy: Next week, we celebrate the enduring legacy of John Coltrane on what would have been his 100th birthday. Dive into his groundbreaking discography. #Jazz

moments.title: Happy 77th to Bruce Springsteen
moments.blurb: The Boss, Bruce Springsteen, celebrates his 77th birthday next Wednesday, September 23, 2026.

angles.name: The Boss Turns 77
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the legendary Bruce Springsteen next Wednesday! What's your favourite song from The Boss? #BruceSpringsteen

angles.name: Celebrating a Rock Icon
angles.copy: Next Wednesday, we're celebrating the one and only Bruce Springsteen's 77th birthday! His music continues to inspire generations. #HappyBirthdayBruce

moments.title: Happy 56th to Ani DiFranco
moments.blurb: Influential folk-punk singer-songwriter Ani DiFranco turns 56 next Wednesday, September 23, 2026.

angles.name: Folk-Punk Icon Birthday
angles.copy: A true independent spirit! Happy 56th Birthday to the incredible Ani DiFranco next Wednesday. Her voice and lyrics continue to resonate. #AniDiFranco

moments.title: Happy 83rd to Julio Iglesias
moments.blurb: Global music superstar Julio Iglesias celebrates his 83rd birthday next Wednesday, September 23, 2026.

angles.name: Romantic Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 83rd Birthday to the legendary Julio Iglesias next Wednesday! His timeless romantic ballads have captivated millions. #JulioIglesias

moments.title: Autumn Equinox
moments.blurb: Astronomical autumn officially begins next Wednesday, September 23, at 01:05 BST, marking the Autumn Equinox.

angles.name: Hello Autumn
angles.copy: The leaves are turning and the nights are drawing in! Astronomical autumn officially begins next Wednesday with the Autumn Equinox. Get ready for cosy season! #AutumnEquinox

angles.name: Equal Day, Equal Night
angles.copy: Next Wednesday marks the Autumn Equinox, when day and night are almost equal length before the nights truly draw in. Enjoy the last of the longer days!
